The '''Belnar sector''' was located in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belnar/Legends|Belnar]], the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Khil]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. The Khil developed [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperspace travel]] technology early on, and Belnar became a member of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and later its successor, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Eventually, the [[Belnar Sector Force]] engaged and defeated the rival [[Peltsic League]] in many [[Skirmishes in Belnar space|skirmishes]] in Belnar [[Realspace/Legends|space]].

==Description==
The Belnar [[Sector/Legends|sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> was located in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="TEA Belnar" /> the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]]. It contained the [[Belnar system/Legends|Belnar system]].<ref name="EAOC" />

==History==
[[File:Belnar-TEA.jpg|thumb|right|220px|The Belnar system and its surroundings]]
The [[Khil]], a [[Species/Legends|species]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belnar/Legends|Belnar]], developed [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperspace travel]] technology by [[25,000 BBY/Legends|25,000 BBY]]. The area of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] surrounding the Belnar [[Star system/Legends|system]] was fully [[Scout/Legends|explored]] by [[20,000 BBY/Legends|20,000 BBY]], although by that [[Time/Legends|time]] Belnar had already been a member of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] for at least two [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> During the first campaigns of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] of [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]&ndash;[[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the [[Third Mid Rim Army|Third Army]] of the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] was tasked with defending Belnar's vicinity against the [[Confederacy military/Legends|military forces]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="EGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

By [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]], the Belnar system was controlled by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="EGTW" /> The worlds inhabited by the Khil were assigned Imperial [[Governor/Legends|governors]] but looked to their former leaders for guidance, and Imperial [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] stationed on Khil worlds remained wary of the general populace due to the Khil viewing the Empire as oppressive.<ref name="GG12">''[[Galaxy Guide 12: Aliens — Enemies and Allies]]''</ref> By [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]'' represents a collection of [[in-universe]] reports from "one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] before the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]," which corresponds to [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> the Khil tactician and [[Navy/Legends|naval]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] [[Tarlo Ganar]] led the [[Belnar Sector Force]] to victory over its inter-system rivals, the [[Peltsic League]], in many [[Skirmishes in Belnar space|skirmishes]] that took place in Belnar space.<ref name="AIR" /> Following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|fragmentation]] of the Galactic Empire<ref name="UAA">''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]''</ref> in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="TEA" /> the Khil living on Belnar and elsewhere became one of the first members of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="UAA" />

==Inhabitants==
The Belnar sector's<ref name="EAOC" /> namesake planet was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] Khil [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="KOTORCG" /> At least one Khil, Commander Tarlo Ganar, was a part of the Belnar Sector Force.<ref name="AIR" />

==Locations==
The Belnar system of the Belnar sector<ref name="EAOC" /> contained the terrestrial planet of the same name, which was home to the sentient Khil species.<ref name="KOTORCG" /> From approximately [[22,000 BBY/Legends|22,000 BBY]] to [[3996 BBY]], the Belnar system was situated on a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] that connected it to the [[Carida system/Legends|Carida]] and [[Yabol Opa system/Legends|Yabol Opa systems]]; however, that [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] route had ceased to exist [[3976 BBY|twenty years]] later.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Belnar sector was first mentioned in the sourcebook ''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]'', published in [[1995]] for use with [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="AIR" /> The [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which was written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], placed the Belnar sector in grid square M-9.<ref name="EAOC" />
